title: Abstraction inventory semantics and clock/scheduler/command/RNG appendix tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual inventory review; full semantic body and four appendix families, remainder explicit
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual partial review covers original1–480: full semantic AB1–AB15 sections, ER18-F1/C1–C15/P1–P5/N1–N9, methods/limits and complete appendix I1–I4 clock/scheduler/command/RNG worklists through the I5 heading. The clipped AB4 paragraph in the first dense read was recovered with full70–85 before credit. Original481–1556 and appended notes remain unreviewed. The474file/site-count census is a historical source-site catalogue with cross-category overlap, not independent service/duplicate counts, current code tracing or permission to remove functions.

F2: Keep multiple actual time coordinates and phase order: native calendar, played elapsed, occupied/lease/local instance, wall conversion and timer cadence are not one scalar. Five equal-looking calendar projections have different admission checks; a shared pure calculation must retain wrappers/units. Boundary providers nested under coordinators differ from independent schedulers, civil claim windows, derived authored-history reset evaluator, remaining-time jobs, animation and watchdog cleanup. Current AD16/ACR8/AD36 qualify absence, buffering and evidence. Later ER1 wave-B profiling in B576 emphasizes facts/clones over a heap-first assumption; this inventory's due-index proposal is not current measured performance need.

F3: Preserve six-lane router/guarded planner/publisher reuse without treating definition IDs as request IDs or conflating timed acceptance, continuous native work, response, voluntary preview and navigation. Exact revision/sequence staleness differs from same-operation durable dedup. Store/entity tables include immutable definitions, temporary validation sets, caches, JSON slices and actual native model owners; same Map/function name is not a rival authoritative store. Current domain registry/native seams and later modular/host work can supersede selected absent-facade claims; this source census is not a renewed gap inventory or universal ECS/kernel choice.

F4: AB4 already corrects ER12's older native Math.random anchor with seeded_streams/native keyed consumers. Ten xorshift arithmetic sites differ in cursor, seed-zero repair and integer rounding; hashes for names, generated truth, keyed decisions and saved draws remain distinct. unitDecision purity differs from streamSeed missing-state initialization, draw ordinal consumption and keyed receipt publication. Extracting arithmetic cannot merge cursor ownership, reseed frozen jobs or silently switch legacyRound to uniform. Render/preview cannot earn new outcomes; a copied-state peek is not an actually delivered generic API. No gameplay replay equivalence follows from reading declarations.

F5: AB6/AB13 distinguish truth, observer evidence/history, legality/context, public view, accepted-work state and render signature. A bounded log/current monotonic knowledge field is not complete as-of history; authored anchor reconstruction is not arbitrary runtime assertion capture. Dependency-qualified invalidation must include the real native inventory/calendar/registry/actor changes, not expansion sequence alone. AB7/AB8 keep stage-first plans, object-preserving native rollback and post-durable errors separate; a saved success cannot become a retryable failed action because a renderer throws. Descriptor/live identity differs from JSON cloning. Domain codec, save schema, content revision, API version and retained Ink cursor are separate contracts; logical chunking does not authorize partial storage commits.

F6: AB9–AB12 retain actual content admission, installation/native binding, panel mount, world definition/instance/region/run/branch, counted acquisition/custody/body passage/projection/information/inheritance and local-law/runtime/appearance distinctions. A carrier helper must not supply a missing body, source, route, permission or duplicated stock; a real stronger channel may carry more through its declared mechanism. Per-world rules stay local under AD38/AD51; no hunger, offline movement or fixed cheat limit is inferred. AB14/AB15 preserve task-native rendering and format modes: currency decomposition versus price rounding, durations versus calendars, disclosed name versus ID and safe text versus HTML. Known failures/mutation/sign/rounding observations are dated source hypotheses until their actual later owners and checks are read.

F7: P1–P5 effort/risk is an inferred historical schedule, not a current commitment, dependency adoption or launch. Current PROJECT/AD42/AD43/AD51 supersedes the first-milestone premise, old1366 target, human gate and implemented-second-consumer prerequisite. Existing keeper N1–N9 is a semantic boundary list, not a prohibition on justified shared software. Each I1–I4 row was read, including main's native actions, separate simulation/job/event/response/cancel entry points, browser one-shots, native keyed RNG and cosmetic sites; none of their source bodies is freshly verified merely because its pointer appears. No source/census rerun, benchmark, runtime, private save, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actually read original1–480, recovering first AB4 truncation via70–85; standalone remaining output untruncated. Original481–1556/appended notes still open. No source-pointer proxy behavior or full-file credit.
reviews.reopen: Continue actual remaining appendix I5 onward from original481, retain original prefix identity for eventual cumulative full review; selected extraction uses actual current owner/evidence.
